gap: No result ChatGPT got states OUPES's own compatibility matrix: the B2 extra battery (2,048 Wh) lists only the Mega 1/2/3 and Titan 3 (Mega 1 tops out at 2 B2s for 5.12 kWh, Mega 2 at 4 for 10.24 kWh, Mega 3 at 6 for 15.36 kWh), the B5 fits only the Mega 5 and Titan 5, and the 800 W alternator charger is 'Made for Mega & Guardian Series. Not for Exodus Series' — so the Exodus 1200 that three of the ranked pages review appears in neither expansion battery's compatibility list and is expressly excluded from the alternator charger.
standout_why: I read shopsavvy.com's Exodus 1200 TLDR, nerdtechy.com's OUPES 1100W review, maketecheasier.com's OUPES 1100W review and activegearreview.com's Exodus 1200 review. Nerdtechy, maketecheasier and activegearreview don't mention expansion. Shopsavvy states no expansion-battery support. None of the four mentions the alternator charger or says which extra battery fits which model. Activegearreview gives only 'panels up to 240W', and maketecheasier gives a '200 watts' solar maximum for the 1100W. I could not open the ranked OUPES pages (result 6, the oupes.com Mega Series page, and result 9, ca.oupes.com Exodus 1200) because oupes.com returned HTTP 429 on every page request. Result 6 may show the per-Mega 'Expandable up to … with B2' lines, so the per-model B2 limits could partly overlap with it. The Exodus exclusion from the alternator charger and the B2/B5 split were not on any rival page I could read.
decides: It splits the pick into two families. A shopper who wants to add battery or charge from a vehicle alternator later should buy a Mega rather than an Exodus: of the 1 kWh units, the Mega 1 at $699 takes up to 2 B2s and the 800 W alternator charger, while the Exodus 1200 at $549 (listed '(Sold Out)') is in neither expansion battery's compatibility list and is excluded from the alternator charger. A shopper who wants a fixed-size camping unit loses nothing with an Exodus. The prices also show the Mega 1 + B2 bundle ($1,379) costs $102 more than buying the Mega 1 ($699) and the B2 ($578) separately ($1,277). Dealectric already lists oupes-mega-1, so the page should lead with the Mega 1 and say plainly which upgrades it accepts.
